pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark brown patches with well-defined, slightly jagged edge gradients. Spatial area is largest on the central flank and decreases toward the posterior regions where patches become smaller and more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream interstitial spaces. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform on the mid-flank but narrows significantly toward the hindquarter region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Serrated mane profile visible along the dorsal ridge from the shoulder to the upper neck, exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical, linear de-pigmented scar is visible on the mid-flank, bisecting several dark patches and intersecting the corridor network nodes.
